meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 收集系统全链路操作日志，生成可追溯的执行证据链与向量索引，是多智能体系统可观测性与安全审计的底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪多智能体系统全链路操作，生成可追溯证据链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在构建多智能体系统时，需要记录操作日志并满足审计需求
copy.tagline_en: Track full-chain operations in multi-agent systems and generate traceable evidence chains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build multi-agent systems that need operation logs and audit trails

howto.what: 装好后，系统里的每次操作（如任务分发、扫描、解析等）都会被记录，生成按 trace_id 串联的证据链和向量索引，供事后检索与审计。
howto.when: 当系统内产生操作事件（如分发、扫描、解析等）或有事件总线推送时触发。

say.text: 查一下 trace_id 为 abc 的完整证据链
say.note: 返回该次操作从分发到执行的留痕记录。

say.text: 列出今天所有官署的卡片生成事件
按官署维度统计最近一小时的扫描操作
say.note: 返回各官署的操作计数与明细。

howto.what_en: Records every operation event (dispatch, scan, parsing, card generation) into a traceable evidence chain and vector index, enabling audit and retrieval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an operation event occurs (e.g. dispatch, scan, parsing) or when pushed via the event bus.

say_en.text: Show the full evidence chain for trace_id abc
say_en.note: Returns the recorded trail from dispatch to execution.

say_en.note: Searches by time window and aggregates results.
